svg.title: Blending poses against blending matrices
svg.desc: Two real renders of the same rig cross-faded halfway between two clips. The pose blend keeps the limb at full length; the matrix blend shortens it and tapers it toward the tip.
svg.text: the same cross-fade, one step apart in the pipeline
identical inputs, identical weight — and the right-hand limb is 0.3498 units shorter
and visibly thinner toward the tip, because the blended matrices are not rotations
and the error accumulates down the chain. Lesson 7.6’s candy wrapper, one level up.
